name: skill-for-skills
description: Automatically discovers, ranks, and loads the best local Skills for an Agent task.

interface.shortDescription: Automatically route tasks to the best local Skills.
interface.longDescription: Scans compatible local Skill directories, ranks installed Skills against the current task, and gives the Agent an ordered route with local SKILL.md paths.
defaultPrompt: Find and load the best local Skills for this task.
Show me which Skills should handle this request.
